name: Telo.Duration

parameters.name: minimum
parameters.description: The shortest duration the slot holds, inclusive — written as a duration (`0s`) or an integer number of milliseconds.

parameters.name: maximum
parameters.description: The longest duration the slot holds, inclusive — written as a duration (`1h`) or an integer number of milliseconds.

parameters.name: exclusiveMinimum
parameters.description: A duration every value must exceed (`0s` for a positive duration) — written as a duration or an integer number of milliseconds.

parameters.name: exclusiveMaximum
parameters.description: A duration every value must stay below — written as a duration or an integer number of milliseconds.

description: A span of time, held as a native duration so it adds to and subtracts from timestamps exactly. Written inline as any CEL duration string (`1h30m`, `250ms`, `30d`; units `ns` to `w`, a day is 24 hours and a week 7 days) or as an integer number of milliseconds (`250`); it is written as seconds (`5400s`). A slot may bound it: `x-telo-type: { name: Telo.Duration, minimum: 0s }`.
